utility_half_life_consumer_swap.name: utility_half_life_consumer_swap

predictions.depends_on: E2 cells (a) R1 THIN F1 used for the |REPLACE-static| >= 10 selection, (b) R2 THIN F2 same reader, (c) B THIN F2 second reader from the closed E0 list; class EP defined as expert items with positive nested-k position value in the reference reader's existing logs, class W planted; about 25 selected EP items with CI +/-5.5, L_W over about 35 items with CI +/-4.6, W-under-B class CI +/-4.5.
predictions.falsifier: L_EP <= 3 net (help transfers), or L_W >= 10 net, or the W class mean under B >= -5 net.
predictions.label: near_entailed
predictions.reason: The EP class is itself selected on the reference reader's own nested-k logs while W is constructed, so EP carries a reader-specific selection that must regress under any second reader and W carries none; the same-reader replication L_RR nets out only the seed-family regression of the |value| >= 10 cut, not this class-level reader-specific selection, so the predicted asymmetry is favoured by construction, and the third clause (-10 versus -5) sits inside the stated +/-4.5 CI.
predictions.fix: Define the EP class by a reader-independent criterion (content, or a third reader's logs) and add the symmetric cell that selects on reader B's values and measures transfer back to reader A, so genuinely reader-independent help can appear as L_EP near zero.

predictions.depends_on: E2 cells (f) R-nat, (g) R-swap with the natural top-1 replaced by the highest-similarity self-pool item, and (h) G with the store grown by 1,892 self-pool items and its own natural top-2; EP items, 96 pairs each, paired-difference CI about +/-4; gate EP mean REPLACE-static in R-nat >= +6 net.
predictions.falsifier: G - R-nat >= 0 net (no collapse), or G - R-swap >= 0 net (the one-item swap already produces the drop).
predictions.label: near_entailed
predictions.reason: The grown store's top-2 are retrieved from a superset and are therefore weakly more similar to the query than the expert top-2, and the pre-registered rule re-runs cell (h) with a self-written top-1 forced in whenever fewer than half the sets contain one, which removes the cleanest route to G - R-nat >= 0, namely a grown store that does not change what is retrieved.
predictions.fix: Keep the unforced grown-store cell as the confirmatory arm and report the forced-in variant separately, so 'store growth leaves the retrieved set unchanged' is a reportable falsifying outcome.

predictions.depends_on: E2 cells (a) R1 on valid_seen, (d) U on type-matched valid_unseen games and (e) U-edit with the location clause removed token-matched, over 40 LS items selected by regex plus manual check; per-cell CI +/-4.5, U-edit - U paired CI about +/-5, R1 - U independent-cells CI about +/-6.4.
predictions.falsifier: the U effect >= -2 net (the reader does not act on a wrong location claim), or R1 - U < 8 net, or U-edit - U <= +3 net (the flip is carried by the rest of the item).
predictions.label: open
predictions.reason: The LS class is selected by content rather than by outcome, and a reader that ignores a stale receptacle claim produces a U effect near zero and a U-edit - U near zero, both reachable and separated from the -10 and +10 bands by more than one CI half-width.

predictions.depends_on: Spearman of the reference Q from E1 against the REPLACE-static ground truth pooled over EP, W and LS (120 items) in cells (a) R1, (c) B and (d) U, with the two-stream test-retest gap as the noise floor; stated SE of the difference of two Spearmans about 0.06; gate Spearman(Q, R1) >= 0.30.
predictions.falsifier: the drop is < 0.10 in both B and U, or does not exceed the E1 test-retest gap by 0.10.
predictions.label: unresolvable
predictions.reason: The predicted drop (>= 0.20) and its falsifier (< 0.10) are 0.10 apart while the stated SE of 0.06 gives a 95% half-width of about 0.12, so the entire decision zone lies inside the stated noise, and P1's own claim that W harm transfers floors the pooled drop precisely in that zone.
predictions.fix: State the prediction on the EP-only correlation, where transferring W values cannot floor it, and size it to at least two SE (or bootstrap over a larger item set until the difference-of-Spearmans half-width is below 0.05).

predictions.depends_on: E3 (i) the B THIN F2 pairs subsampled at 4/8/16/24/48 per item versus E3 (ii) Q_B re-learned on 500/1,000/2,000/3,553 stream games under reader B, both scored by Spearman against criterion K = cell (j), B-condition EP values under NATURAL composition and seed family F3, with K's s5-vs-s6 split-half reliability as the ceiling; 40 items, SE about 0.12 at rho 0.5.
predictions.falsifier: Q_B reaches Spearman 0.5 with K by 1,000 games, or the intervention route is <= 0.25 at 48 pairs.
predictions.label: near_entailed
predictions.reason: K is produced by the same reader, the same REPLACE-static estimator and the same item set as route (i), differing only in composition and seed family, while route (ii) shares only the retrieval regime, so shared method variance favours the intervention curve by construction; the design controls composition and seeds but never the estimator itself.
predictions.fix: Add a second criterion measured by a different estimator under reader B (REMOVE-based values, or a held-out pruning outcome) and require the cost ordering to hold against both criteria.

shared_terms: P1-P4: both are computed from the same R1, R2 and B item values, and P1's claim that W harm transfers floors P4's pooled Spearman drop, so confirming P1 pushes P4 toward its own falsifier (the proposal states this).
P3-P4: the U cell's LS values are simultaneously P3's flip and a component of P4's R1-to-U drop, so one cell decides both.
P1-P5: route (i) of P5 is the same B THIN F2 cell that supplies v'(B) in L_EP, so a compressed reader-B item-value spread both raises L_EP and caps route (i)'s correlation with K.
P2-P1: cells (f)-(h) reuse the EP class defined by the reference reader's nested-k logs, so P2's store-growth drop inherits P1's reader-specific class selection.

guilt_by_coretrieval.name: guilt_by_coretrieval

predictions.depends_on: Pass A/A' versus M1/M2 on a frozen expert bank with per-item dose randomised over {0, 0.5, 1} at the rank-2 slot (token-matched placebo replacement at every dose), per-item Q averaged over 24 scheduled outcomes, clean LOO from E2(i) forced-retrieval WITH versus REPLACE-static3, and the A-vs-A' test-retest as noise floor.
predictions.falsifier: Spearman(per-item Q, clean LOO) falls by less than 0.10 from pass A to the mean of M1/M2 with the item-level bootstrap CI excluding 0.20, or the drop does not exceed the A-vs-A' test-retest difference.
predictions.label: open
predictions.reason: Dose is assigned orthogonally to true item value and the induced Q shift (about 10 net, i.e. ~0.10 in success rate) is of the same order as the per-item Q SE (0.10) and the between-item spread of true value, so a near-zero drop is genuinely attainable and a true null (point estimate ~0, CI half-width ~0.16 at the stated SE 0.08) does exclude 0.20; the only weakness is that the conjunctive falsifier fires only for drops below about 0.04, leaving 0.04-0.20 indeterminate rather than falsifying.

predictions.depends_on: Offline scorers refit on the same M1/M2 logs (MemQ TD(lambda) at 0.5/0.9 over the retrieval DAG, RoMeRL state at dim 4/16/64, flag-oracle Q updated only from W-free episodes), with recovery expressed as a fraction of the P1 drop measured against the same E2(i) LOO.
predictions.falsifier: MemQ or RoMeRL reaches Spearman >= per-item Q + 0.15 (>= 75% of the drop) with the bootstrap CI excluding 25% of the drop; the prediction is instead declared void if the flag-oracle recovers < 50%.
predictions.label: unresolvable
predictions.reason: At the pre-registered drop of 0.20 the falsifying band requires a recovery of +0.15 whose CI excludes +0.05, which at the proposal's own dependent-correlation SE of 0.08 needs a point estimate of about +0.21 - more than the entire drop - so the falsifier sits outside the stated power unless the observed drop is far above the MDE, and the void clause plus a flag-oracle that has no W-free scheduled episodes at all for the 40 dose-1 items gives the prediction a second exit from falsification.
predictions.fix: Score P2 only when the observed P1 drop exceeds a pre-registered floor (e.g. 0.35), state its own MDE from a paired item-bootstrap of the scorer-difference (whose SE should be estimated empirically from A vs A', not inherited from the A-vs-M SE), and add a dose-0.75 or partial-W schedule so dose-1 items retain W-free episodes for the flag-oracle to update from.

predictions.depends_on: Corrected-Q re-runs on M1 scheduled episodes only, flip-only update, nested 10/20/40% subsample over all 120 items versus a 100% ceiling computed on a 40-item stratified subset, compared with Spearman(Q, LOO) on pass A (120 items) and on M1.
predictions.falsifier: The 20% scorer is <= per-item Q + 0.05 with CI excluding +0.10 while the 100% ceiling reaches pass-A level, or the 100% ceiling itself stays below pass-A level minus 0.10.
predictions.label: unresolvable
predictions.reason: Both falsifying branches hinge on the 100% ceiling, a Spearman over 40 items (SE ~0.165, CI ~+/-0.32) compared against a 120-item pass-A correlation on a different item set, so the 0.05 and 0.10 margins lie well inside the ceiling's own noise, and branch one additionally demands a difference whose CI excludes +0.10 at SE 0.08 (point estimate <= -0.06) while being <= +0.05.
predictions.fix: Run the 100% corrected-Q ceiling on the same 120 items, or restrict every term in P3 (pass-A, M1, 20%, 100%) to the identical 40-item subset and pre-register a paired item-bootstrap MDE for that 40-item contrast.

predictions.depends_on: E3 class-level interaction I = s_full - s_-B - s_-W(or -B') + s_-both over 40 helpful+conflicting and 40 helpful+redundant sets, 16 games x 2 seeds paired, per-set SE ~15 net and class SE ~2.4 net.
predictions.falsifier: Class-mean I > -5 net with the 95% CI excluding -10 in either kind, i.e. single-removal LOO is a fair (additive) estimator.
predictions.label: open
predictions.reason: The conflicting kind can genuinely come out additive (a -10-net W and a +17-net B adding without masking gives I near 0) and at class SE 2.4 an estimate above -5 does exclude -10, so the disjunctive falsifier is both reachable and resolvable - although the redundant half is close to a restatement of how that pool was built, since B and B' are selected as same-type, same-procedure duplicates and I then equals minus the pair-removal effect by construction.

predictions.depends_on: E4 bottom-quartile (30 items) of each pass's Q vector crossed with clean LOO from E2, on passes A, M1, M2, with dose composition and the false-prune rate (bottom-quartile items whose clean LOO >= +5 net), the ratio clause conditioned on the pass-A rate lying in [0.10, 0.45].
predictions.falsifier: Dose-1 items are <= 13 of the 30 pruned items in both mixed passes, or the false-prune rate ratio is < 1.3 with the paired-bootstrap CI excluding 2.
predictions.label: open
predictions.reason: Bottom-quartile enrichment is a magnitude question, not a re-description: a ~10-net dose shift against a per-item Q SE of 0.10 plus true-value spread plausibly lands at 12-14 of 30, exactly the falsifying region, and 13 versus 18 is about 2 binomial SE apart - though the false-prune-ratio clause taken alone would be unresolvable, since a ratio of two proportions estimated on 30 items each cannot have a CI that separates 1.3 from 2.

predictions.depends_on: E0(a) W-class clean-composition value over 40 planted items (3,840 episodes, CI +/-4.5) and E0(b) within-B Spearman(pass-A Q, LOO) on the first 60 ground-truthed items (SE ~0.12) plus A-vs-A' Q test-retest, all scored before M1.
predictions.falsifier: W-class clean value > -10 net (manipulation does not manufacture harm) or within-B Spearman < 0.25 / test-retest < 0.5 (scorer invalid), which halts the confirmatory cells.
predictions.label: open
predictions.reason: Both gates are empirical magnitudes with reachable failure - the reader can ignore or override a rank-2 wrong-procedure item, and the stratified B class can have too little true spread to reach 0.25 - and away from the thresholds the outcomes are clearly separated, even though the pass/fail decision is a bare point-estimate comparison whose boundary is blurred by SE 0.12 (E0b) and +/-4.5 net (E0a).

shared_terms: P1-P2: P2's recovery is defined as a percentage of P1's Spearman drop and reuses the identical pass-A and mixed-pass Spearman(Q, LOO) anchors, so P1's measured drop fixes both the denominator and the absolute size of P2's thresholds.

P1-P5: the bottom-quartile dose composition and false-prune rate are coarsenings of the same mixed-pass Q vector and the same clean-LOO values that define P1's rank correlation, so a large P1 drop largely determines P5's enrichment and vice versa.

P2-P3: the flag-oracle (P2) and the 100% corrected-Q ceiling (P3) are two estimates of the same de-pooled upper bound and both are scored as recovery against the shared measured pair Spearman(Q, LOO on M1) and Spearman(Q, LOO on pass A).

P1-P6: E0(b)'s gate quantity is Spearman(pass-A Q, LOO) over 60 of the same 120 items - the exact baseline term P1's drop is measured from - so the gate value sets the ceiling on how large a drop P1 can report.

P1/P3/P5-P4: P1, P3 and P5 all treat the single-removal REPLACE-static3 LOO as ground truth, which is precisely the estimator P4 tests for additivity, so a strong P4 non-additivity finding reinterprets the shared LOO term rather than supplying an independent one.
